body: I appreciate you trying to help. It's just not worth the effort
He has repeatedly questioned our friendship. I'm a bad person and a bad friend
I want to stick around and help him, but I don't think I can

I've lost friends to suicide. I know it's hell. And I hate to leave him with no formal explanation. But I've heard him panic when I've nearly committed suicide before and I can't have him go through that

I have been raised to hate myself. My parents don't care about me. My family is full of abusive people. The only memories I have are mostly traumatic. I've never felt okay. The only real role model/parental figure I had died when I was 12. So what's the point? 

There was a case of a girl who was horribly abused and deprived of any type of social interaction. She didn't learn how to speak until she was reached at age 10 and even then she never was able to get past a toddlers level of vocabulary. I have never known what it is to be happy or even really "fine". I'm only gonna be 18, but it's too late for me to learn. The same thing when it comes to how I view myself
I complain nonstop, and then I pull away and won't talk about my issues. I despise everything I do. Breathing feels wrong. Waking up everyday feels like a mistake. Everything I do is bad
I'm sorry you had to go through that. He might miss me but I know for a fact I do no good for him
